name: Diagnosis
descriptionTemplate: This turn, each time the wielder takes Active or {Tentacle DMG}, they gain 1 stack of {Diagnostic Records} at the start of next turn. Each stack makes their "Command Cards" count as having [DescArg1] {plural:[DescArg1]|stack|stacks} of {Enhance}, stacking up to 5 times. Removed at turn end.
